_comment: Provenance for freetsa-token.b64 — a REAL RFC-3161 TimeStampResp captured live from freetsa.org for a permanent regression fixture (trust-ladder Slice B review finding #2). Fetched by a one-off script, NOT part of the test suite or CI — zero network calls happen when the tests that use this fixture run. Re-fetch only if freetsa.org's response shape ever changes in a way that breaks the fixture (unlikely) or freetsa.org disappears (fetch against a different public TSA and update this file).
note: digestHex = sha256(digestInput) — the exact 64-char hex digest that was timestamped. test/tsa.test.ts asserts imprintMatches(token, digestHex) === true and imprintMatches(token, <any other digest>) === false against this real token.
